description: This Java class 'Node' models a node in a task/activity tree for Android intents, supporting parcelable serialization, comparison, and tree structure management.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a task/activity tree, with properties for task ID, component name, intent, children, and flags, supporting parceling, comparison, and tree operations.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node's children list.

methods.name: addFirstChild
methods.description: Adds a child node at the beginning of this node's children list.

methods.name: clearChildren
methods.description: Removes all children from this node.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Checks if the node is marked as modified.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets or clears the modified flag.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the node is marked as new.

methods.name: setNew
methods.description: Sets or clears the new flag.

methods.name: isCurrent
methods.description: Checks if the node is marked as current.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Marks the node as current or not.

methods.name: setIntent
methods.description: Sets the intent associated with this node.

methods.name: getIntent
methods.description: Returns the intent associated with this node.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines if this node is structurally equal to another node.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this node to another based on task ID or component name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including flags, ID, name, intent, and children.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the node into a Parcel.

methods.name: describeContents
methods.description: Returns a bitmask indicating special object types (usually 0).
